findings.narrativeExcerpt: The story is about Voyager 2’s close-up study of Neptune in 1989: it was the first—and remains the only—spacecraft to study the planet up close. Readers should understand that this encounter has not been repeated by another spacecraft.
findings.relation: The source identifies Voyager 2 as the only spacecraft to study Neptune up close; the candidate’s claim that no other spacecraft has repeated the encounter preserves that exclusivity.
